newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Petronas crude differentials under review still.
newsitem.headline: Petronas crude differentials under review still.

text.p: Malaysia's state-owned Petronas is still reviewing the price differential of Miri and Labuan crudes against benchmark Tapis, industry sources said on Wednesday.
Petronas earlier Wednesday released its monthly retroactive official selling prices for June, which showed no change in differentials.
The June official selling price (OSP) of Miri crude was set at Tapis OSP +10 cents per barrel, while Labuan was set at Tapis +15 -- both in line with the first five months of the year.
Bintulu OSP was set at Tapis -40 cents, which was also unchanged.
A source said Petronas has not decided whether Miri and Labuan's relationship with Tapis will remain the same for the rest of the year or not.
Petronas is expected to make a final decision by the end of July, the source said.

During six-monthly meeting with term contract customers held in June, Petronas agreed to review the OSPs of its crudes after buyers expressed concern that the OSP of Miri crude was at a premium over Tapis, although it was considered a lower quality
The last time Petronas adjusted its OSP differentials was in January, when the Miri OSP was raised to Tapis +10, from Tapis -10 previously.
Labuan was raised to Tapis +15 from Tapis +10 cents.
